title: New Bedford man arrested after allegedly assaulting priest with beer can, police say
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Local News The incident occurred at Our Lady of Mount Carmel in New Bedford on Monday evening, according to authorities.
A New Bedford man was arrested Monday after he allegedly assaulted a priest, punching him and hitting him with a beer can, according to police.

Jose Nascimento, 59, faces one felony charge of assault and battery with a dangerous weapon, as well as misdemeanor charges of assault and battery, threatening to commit a crime, disturbing the peace, and disorderly conduct.
